description: This file defines the HuggingFaceInference class, which extends the LLM class to provide integration with Hugging Face's inference API. It includes configuration options, environment variable handling for API keys, and methods for making text generation calls.

classes.name: HuggingFaceInference
classes.description: A class that interfaces with Hugging Face's inference API, extending the LLM class to provide customizable text generation capabilities.

methods.name: _llmType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for the LLM, which is 'hf' for Hugging Face.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Performs a text generation call to Hugging Face's API with specified prompt and options.

methods.name: imports
methods.description: Dynamically imports the HfInference class from '@huggingface/inference' package.
